title: Accessible decision research input
description: Research public evidence for a hands-free decision. Never include credentials, cookies, private documents, or personal data.

selectedUrl.title: Selected public URL
selectedUrl.description: Optional public http(s) page the user is looking at.

selectedText.title: Selected page text
selectedText.description: Optional non-sensitive excerpt, capped at 4,000 characters.

question.title: Decision question
question.description: The comparison, fact-check, or decision question to research using current public sources.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: Budget, accessibility, location, time, or other decision requirements.

allowedDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowedDomains.description: Optional domains to include in research.

blockedDomains.title: Blocked domains
blockedDomains.description: Optional domains to exclude from research.

preferPrimarySources.title: Prefer primary sources
preferPrimarySources.description: Prefer official and first-party sources when they are available.

maxSources.title: Maximum independent sources
maxSources.description: Maximum number of independently retrieved public sources to compare.

maxItems.title: Maximum output records
maxItems.description: Hard limit on normalized evidence records written to the output dataset.

maxRuntimeSecs.title: Maximum runtime
maxRuntimeSecs.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for child research runs.

maxChargeUsd.title: Maximum child-run charge
maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum combined charge in US dollars allocated across child Actor runs.

privacyMode.title: Privacy mode
privacyMode.description: Controls whether selected page text may be included in child research inputs.
